newsitem.title: UK: MOTOR RACING-Stewart F1 racing team signs Malaysian govt deal.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-Stewart F1 racing team signs Malaysian govt deal.

text.p: Three times world champion Jackie Stewart said on Wednesday his new Formula One Grand Prix team had signed a one-year sponsorship deal with the Malaysian government.

"This is the first time a nation has sponsored a Formula One team to this extent," Stewart said at a news conference in the Malaysian High Commission here. "I think it illustates Malaysia's interest in expansion."

Stewart would not reveal how much the deal was worth but said it was unlikely he would need another major sponsor following his announcement earlier this year of a multi-million pound deal with the Hong Kong and Shanghai Banking Corporation.
"I am on record as saying it is about a 20 million pound ($33.5 million) effort for a full programme, and although some teams operate on less than that, that is probably what we will have.
"Scots never talk about money and we would prefer to keep the details of this arrangement among ourselves. The funding is pretty much in place," he said.
